_doc: Outdated-terminology rules. kind: renamed = same capability under a new name (informational); deprecated = feature retired or scheduled for retirement; possibly_outdated = recommendation may no longer be best practice and needs verification. 'verified_obsolete' is never assigned automatically. severity 0 = informational only (does not mark the question as legacy).

rules.modern: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (the June 2026 guide's name for the Vertex AI platform). Product capabilities are equivalent; only the branding changed.
AI Platform (Unified/Legacy) was superseded by Vertex AI, now branded Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Map AI Platform Training/Prediction to custom training jobs and endpoints.
Cloud ML Engine became AI Platform and then Vertex AI / Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
Replaced by Agent Platform Workbench instances and Colab Enterprise.
Vertex AI Workbench managed and user-managed notebooks were deprecated in favor of Workbench instances; Colab Enterprise is the managed collaborative option.
Cloud Datalab was retired; use Agent Platform Workbench or Colab Enterprise.
Standalone AutoML products were consolidated into Agent Platform AutoML (tabular, image, text, video).

The current Agent Platform Feature Store is BigQuery-backed (feature groups, feature views, online stores). Entity types/featurestores belong to Feature Store (Legacy); verify the recommended pattern.
The June 2026 guide calls this Managed Service for Apache Airflow (formerly Cloud Composer).
Cloud Functions is now Cloud Run functions.
Container Registry was shut down; use Artifact Registry.
Vertex AI Matching Engine is now Vector Search.
PaLM-family models were retired and superseded by Gemini models.
Now Vertex AI Studio within Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
Cloud Data Loss Prevention is now part of Sensitive Data Protection (DLP API remains).
Cloud IoT Core was retired in 2023; use partner IoT platforms with Pub/Sub.
The managed human data labeling service has been discontinued for most use cases; verify the current labeling options.
Superseded by Agent Platform Pipelines (serverless KFP/TFX).
Estimators are deprecated in TensorFlow 2; Keras APIs are recommended.
TensorFlow Enterprise images were discontinued; use standard Deep Learning Containers.
Cloud Source Repositories is closed to new customers; use GitHub/GitLab/Secure Source Manager with Cloud Build.
Verify availability; BigQuery data preparation and Dataflow are the commonly recommended alternatives.
